objective: Expand external historical test geographic radius from 2 states to 15 NEW UFs across five regions, excluding all previously examined municipalities
municipal_code_discovery: exact UF and normalized official NM_MUNICIPIO string, no vote totals or outcome based selection
second_round_candidate_order: two distinct official second-round candidate numbers, ordered numerically, NOT sorted by vote totals

checkpoint_grid.detail: 1%..100% of sections first totalized by internal TSE time
checkpoint_grid.tie: all section events with identical timestamp are jointly observed

holdout_gate: all 15 municipalities must meet all rules; blocked source/city is failure, no replacement
source_policy: Download official TSE ZIPs, record SHA256 and CRC and per-city reconstructed input SHA256 in data-only phase; freeze generated manifest before scoring; never rely on newer 2026 geocoordinates for 2024
limitations: Retrospectively reconstructed first-totalization times are not authenticated public snapshots
City roster known historically to developer, and selection not random: not prospective blind validation
Votes at multiple checkpoints are correlated within election
No distance-based search is used by V6; radius here means geographic coverage of external holdout
